name: hud_sensor_tracker_show_objective_pickup_info
description: HudSensorTracker::ShowObjectivePickupInfo shows or hides the pickup objective panel, formats weapon stats and feature text, and optionally starts the auto-advance deadline. Direct production host: mission.cpp.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session; coverage is functional through native HUD objective pickup tests and accepted callee targets.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x418940 validates the visible/hide split, feature string assembly from OptCatalog flags, impact-proximity and non-proximity stat formats, opt metadata lookup, HudUiMgrObjective::Show call, objectiveUiMode transitions, and auto-advance deadline update.
The native HUD sensor tracker smoke verifies visible auto-advance mode/deadline, objective image lookup, summary/description text content, feature text content, and hide transition behavior.
